entities.name: St. Stephen's Cathedral, Litoměřice
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The St. Stephen's Cathedral or simply Cathedral of Litoměřice, is the name given to a religious building of the Catholic Church that works as a cathedral of the Diocese of Litoměřice, and is also one of the most important cultural sites in the city. It is protected as a cultural monument of the Czech Republic.
